operation_mapping.collision_rule: A derived-reference collision never converges by reference alone. The owner row must have exactly one FILE_QUARANTINED audit whose correlation_id equals the LawOS correlation and whose request_id equals the complete request fingerprint; any mismatch fails closed before bytes, queue, scan, or promotion are reused.

successor_algorithm.rule: Resolve tenant, actor, Matter, permission, Ethical Wall, Records handling and the truthful DLP ingress state from authenticated server authority before deriving an owner; no client tenant or actor is trusted.
Normalize filename and MIME, hash the bounded bytes, derive the UUIDv5 quarantine reference from the server-created operation ID, and acquire a tenant-and-operation transaction advisory lock.

Under the lock, read the scan, immutable promotion input and exactly one FILE_QUARANTINED audit. Exact material returns the existing state; any owner, correlation, request fingerprint, resource or file drift returns a conflict.

When no owner row exists, putIfAbsent the deterministic quarantine object while the bounded database transaction remains open. An existing object may be adopted only after tenant-safe readback proves the exact SHA-256, byte size and MIME; collision or drift never deletes it.

Insert the scan, strict public promotion fields, queue job and FILE_QUARANTINED audit in one tenant transaction. The audit correlation_id carries the LawOS correlation, request_id carries the complete request fingerprint, and hash carries the content SHA-256.

The worker claims the scan with FOR UPDATE using tenant, quarantine reference and expected SHA-256, reloads the immutable owner audit binding, and creates at most one append-only promotion receipt before the scan can become promoted.

Status derives the same opaque reference, checks the owner binding, reauthorizes current policy, and returns success only after exactly one promotion joins the exact document version and file object whose SHA-256, size and MIME independently match.

proof_cases.claim: One durable operation owner is representable without a new table or column.
Concurrent identical requests can converge on one quarantine row, one queue identity and one eventual promotion receipt.
Reuse of the same operation with changed authority, resource, request fingerprint or file material can fail closed before reuse.
A crash after object creation but before transaction commit can be repaired by exact readback, while row-without-object and other orphans remain visible to reconciliation.
Asynchronous scan and promotion can preserve operation correlation and return one exact immutable version without adding upload authority to LawOS.

current_source_gaps.gap: QuarantineIntakeService uses randomUUID for every request and therefore cannot resolve an accepted AMIC OS operation after a process restart.
Current intake does not compare a server-owned operation correlation and complete request fingerprint before treating an existing quarantine object or row as a replay.
Current FILE_QUARANTINED, scan and promotion calls do not deliberately propagate one LawOS correlation through the asynchronous worker.
Vault main exposes no delegated AMIC OS upload status and exact readback provider route.
The migration-zero algorithm and its real PostgreSQL, storage, replica, restart and policy negative tests do not exist in Vault main.
